nodes.label: Central love story with HEA
nodes.description: The central romantic relationship drives the story and resolves in a durable happily-ever-after.
prompt_semantics: Make the central relationship structurally indispensable and direct the long arc toward a durable shared future.
evaluation_semantics: At book scope, verify that the central love story resolves in a credible durable union; do not demand this resolution from an opening scene.

nodes.label: Central love story with HFN
nodes.description: The central romantic relationship drives the story and resolves happily for the present.
prompt_semantics: Make the central relationship structurally indispensable and direct the ending toward a credible happy-for-now commitment.
evaluation_semantics: At book scope, verify a satisfying present commitment without requiring permanent closure.

nodes.label: Serial romantic arc unresolved
nodes.description: The installment advances but does not resolve the central romance.
prompt_semantics: Deliver a meaningful relationship turn while preserving a live series-level romantic question.
evaluation_semantics: Verify installment-level progress and a deliberate unresolved romantic hook.

nodes.label: Romance
nodes.description: Fiction organized around the development and outcome of a central love relationship.
prompt_semantics: Make romantic change causal rather than decorative.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that romantic progress changes knowledge, trust, desire, choice, or future possibility.

nodes.label: Contemporary romance
nodes.description: Romance in a recognizably contemporary social world.
prompt_semantics: Ground attraction and impediment in contemporary institutions, language, and material life.
evaluation_semantics: Verify contemporary social and institutional plausibility.

nodes.label: Romantic suspense
nodes.description: Romance whose relationship arc and danger or investigation plot exert pressure on one another.
prompt_semantics: Make danger, uncertainty, or investigation alter intimacy, trust, and romantic choice.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that suspense and romance are causally interlocked rather than parallel tracks.

nodes.label: Historical romance
nodes.description: Romance in a historical period whose institutions materially constrain the relationship.
prompt_semantics: Let historically specific law, custom, work, and reputation shape romantic possibility.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the period changes the relationship rather than serving as costume.

nodes.label: Fantasy romance or romantasy
nodes.description: Romance integrated with a confirmed fantastic world or magical plot.
prompt_semantics: Make magic and romantic choice constrain and transform one another.
evaluation_semantics: Verify dual-arc convergence between romance and confirmed fantastic stakes.

nodes.label: Paranormal romance
nodes.description: Romance featuring confirmed supernatural beings or powers.
prompt_semantics: Treat the supernatural premise as real and make it shape intimacy and danger.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that paranormal status is confirmed and causally relevant.

nodes.label: Dark romance
nodes.description: Romance foregrounding transgression, threat, or morally dangerous relationship dynamics.
prompt_semantics: Make danger and transgression integral to the relationship contract and consequences.
evaluation_semantics: Judge darkness, consent, and heat independently; do not infer one from another.

nodes.label: Erotic romance
nodes.description: Romance in which explicit sexual development is a major vehicle of the central relationship arc.
prompt_semantics: Make sexual development reveal and alter the central relationship rather than functioning as detachable spectacle.
evaluation_semantics: Verify both the romance contract and the causal emotional function of explicit intimacy.

nodes.label: Faith-driven romance
nodes.description: Romance in which faith materially shapes desire, decision, commitment, and repair.
prompt_semantics: Make faith operate through attention, freedom, sacrifice, decision, and consequence rather than detachable exposition.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that faith causally shapes the romantic arc.

nodes.label: Romantic comedy
nodes.description: Romance whose central courtship is driven by comic friction and revelation.
prompt_semantics: Use comic reversals to expose character and intensify romantic stakes.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that humor changes relationship knowledge rather than merely decorating dialogue.

nodes.label: Four-phase romance
nodes.description: Setup, adhesion, deepening, and resolution organize the relationship arc.
prompt_semantics: Place each scene inside a legible phase of setup, adhesion, deepening, or resolution.
evaluation_semantics: Judge the scene by its phase-specific relationship work.

nodes.label: Dual-arc convergence
nodes.description: The romance and external plot develop separately but repeatedly transform one another.
prompt_semantics: Make every major external turn alter romantic knowledge or choice, and every romantic turn alter the external problem.
evaluation_semantics: Verify reciprocal causality between the romance and external plot.

nodes.label: Slow-burn convergence
nodes.description: Recognition accumulates through delayed, consequential advances.
prompt_semantics: Accumulate desire through specific recognition, impediment, and chosen restraint; every delay must produce new knowledge.
evaluation_semantics: Verify progression rather than repetitive deferral.

nodes.label: Early adhesion
nodes.description: The pair becomes bound early, shifting tension toward survival, trust, or moral consequence.
prompt_semantics: Bind the central pair early and derive tension from what continued attachment costs.
evaluation_semantics: Verify credible early adhesion and escalating consequences.

nodes.label: Thriller
nodes.description: A danger-driven external plot organized around escalating threat and consequential revelation.
prompt_semantics: Escalate threat through causal revelations and costly choices.
evaluation_semantics: Verify rising danger and meaningful reversals.

nodes.label: Psychological investigation
nodes.description: The external plot investigates perception, belief, influence, or uncertain motives.
prompt_semantics: Keep observation, interpretation, and mechanism separable while pressure rises.
evaluation_semantics: Verify multiple live explanations and an evidence-changing control or revelation.

nodes.label: Psychotechnology investigation
nodes.description: An investigation of attention-shaping, nonverbal influence, ritual, and apparent extraordinary cognition.
prompt_semantics: Dramatize psychotechnology through observable cues, experiments, incentives, and residual uncertainty.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that mechanisms are discoverable through action and that a smaller unexplained remainder can survive.

nodes.label: Institutional drama
nodes.description: Status, governance, incentives, and belonging generate external conflict.
prompt_semantics: Express institutional incentives through behavior, access, ritual, and unequal social risk.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that institutional structure changes what characters can safely say and do.

nodes.label: Mystery
nodes.description: A question-driven plot whose evidence is progressively reinterpreted.
prompt_semantics: Let each answer sharpen or transform the governing question.
evaluation_semantics: Verify evidence progression and a fair but non-obvious turn.

nodes.label: Quest
nodes.description: A goal-directed journey requiring escalating trials and alliance.
prompt_semantics: Use each trial to change both capability and relationship.
evaluation_semantics: Verify causal trials and accumulating alliance.

nodes.label: Standalone couple
nodes.description: One couple receives a complete romantic resolution in one volume.
prompt_semantics: Complete the central pair's arc within the volume while preserving world-level sequel possibilities.
evaluation_semantics: Verify volume-level romantic closure.

nodes.label: Interconnected standalones
nodes.description: Each volume resolves a different couple within a shared social world.
prompt_semantics: Resolve the featured couple while introducing future leads through independent desire and conflict.
evaluation_semantics: Verify current-couple closure without sequel-bait displacement.

nodes.label: Same-couple sequence
nodes.description: Multiple volumes develop one central couple through successive commitments and crises.
prompt_semantics: Give each installment a meaningful relationship achievement while preserving later developmental work.
evaluation_semantics: Verify installment progress and series-level continuity.

nodes.label: Duet
nodes.description: A two-volume central romance with a deliberate first-volume rupture or cliffhanger.
prompt_semantics: Build the first volume toward a relationship-altering rupture that demands the second.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the cliffhanger is earned by the romantic and external arcs.

nodes.label: Open ensemble
nodes.description: An ensemble supports overlapping and potentially continuing romantic arcs.
prompt_semantics: Maintain distinct relational trajectories and prevent ensemble motion from obscuring the focal arc.
evaluation_semantics: Verify focal clarity and continuity across overlapping arcs.

nodes.label: Proximity tropes
nodes.description: Circumstances repeatedly place the central pair together.
prompt_semantics: Use repeated proximity to create new knowledge, choices, and costs.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that proximity changes the relationship.

nodes.label: Forced proximity
nodes.description: External circumstances make sustained contact difficult to avoid.
prompt_semantics: Make unavoidable contact intensify attention while preserving meaningful choice.
evaluation_semantics: Identify the constraint and the resulting relationship change.

nodes.label: Institutional proximity
nodes.description: Shared work, training, residence, or membership produces repeated contact.
prompt_semantics: Use institutional duties and observation to make encounters consequential.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that institutional proximity changes access, reputation, or choice.

nodes.label: Only one bed
nodes.description: A constrained sleeping arrangement forces negotiation of intimacy and boundaries.
prompt_semantics: Make the sleeping constraint reveal desire, trust, and boundary-setting.
evaluation_semantics: Verify a meaningful negotiated response rather than automatic consummation.

nodes.label: Enemies to lovers
nodes.description: Meaningful opposition transforms into romantic attachment.
prompt_semantics: Give the opposition substantive stakes and let attraction complicate rather than erase disagreement.
evaluation_semantics: Verify credible opposition, revised knowledge, and an earned change in allegiance.

nodes.label: Friends to lovers
nodes.description: An existing friendship becomes explicitly romantic.
prompt_semantics: Make romantic recognition threaten and deepen an established friendship.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the friendship materially shapes the romantic risk.

nodes.label: Slow burn
nodes.description: Desire and attachment accumulate through consequential delays.
prompt_semantics: Make each delayed advance produce recognition, trust, vulnerability, or a harder future choice.
evaluation_semantics: Distinguish accumulating tension from stalled repetition.

nodes.label: Competence attraction
nodes.description: Skill, perception, judgment, or restraint becomes erotically and morally attractive.
prompt_semantics: Let attraction arise from witnessed skill, judgment, or costly restraint in action.
evaluation_semantics: Quote the action that generates attraction and identify what it reveals.

nodes.label: Charged restraint
nodes.description: Chosen non-taking intensifies perception, trust, and desire.
prompt_semantics: Make restraint active, socially or emotionally costly, and hotter because it increases freedom and perception.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that restraint changes relationship knowledge and does not merely end the scene.

nodes.label: Mysterious protector
nodes.description: A capable figure protects without fully explaining motives or history.
prompt_semantics: Reveal protection through costly action while preserving an answerable question about motive or history.
evaluation_semantics: Verify both the protective action and the remaining mystery.

nodes.label: Found family
nodes.description: Chosen bonds form a durable community of belonging.
prompt_semantics: Build belonging through reciprocal risk, work, hospitality, and repair.
evaluation_semantics: Verify mutual obligation rather than instant group warmth.

nodes.label: Forbidden attraction
nodes.description: A real duty, rule, identity, or social cost makes attraction dangerous to act upon.
prompt_semantics: Make the prohibition specific and let desire sharpen rather than dissolve moral agency.
evaluation_semantics: Verify a real impediment and a chosen response.

nodes.label: Marriage of convenience
nodes.description: A practical marriage contract becomes emotionally and romantically real.
prompt_semantics: Use the practical agreement to expose unmet needs, negotiated duties, and changing desire.
evaluation_semantics: Verify the transition from instrument to chosen union.

external_mappings.label: Romance: fake relationship or marriage of convenience

nodes.label: Fake dating
nodes.description: A performed relationship creates real attachment and social consequences.
prompt_semantics: Make performed intimacy reveal genuine preferences and raise the cost of disclosure.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the performance changes the real relationship.

nodes.label: Second chance
nodes.description: A previous relationship receives a credible opportunity for repair.
prompt_semantics: Make renewed desire confront the concrete cause of the earlier failure.
evaluation_semantics: Verify restitution, changed capacity, and a non-nostalgic basis for reunion.

nodes.label: Morally grey protector
nodes.description: A protective figure uses ethically contested means.
prompt_semantics: Make protection, danger, attraction, and moral cost simultaneously legible.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that competence does not erase responsibility.

nodes.label: Monogamous central pair
nodes.description: The central romantic contract forms around an exclusive pair.
prompt_semantics: Build the central romantic future around mutual exclusive choice.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that exclusivity is chosen and causally meaningful.

nodes.label: Polyamorous relationship
nodes.description: The central romantic contract includes more than two consenting partners.
prompt_semantics: Give each bond independent agency, negotiation, and emotional consequence.
evaluation_semantics: Verify differentiated relationships and explicit relational governance.

nodes.label: Marriage-oriented trajectory
nodes.description: The long arc directs desire and commitment toward marriage.
prompt_semantics: Make marriage a progressively chosen form of shared life rather than a decorative epilogue.
evaluation_semantics: At the appropriate scope, verify increasing capacity for durable covenant.

nodes.label: Nonmarital durable commitment
nodes.description: The long arc directs the central relationship toward durable commitment without marriage.
prompt_semantics: Make the chosen form of durable commitment concrete and reciprocal.
evaluation_semantics: Verify a credible shared future without presuming marriage.

nodes.label: Sheltered competent initiate
nodes.description: A socially inexperienced but genuinely capable protagonist enters a sophisticated world.
prompt_semantics: Let inexperience coexist with real perception, method, and moral agency.
evaluation_semantics: Verify both uncertainty and competence without generic genius.

nodes.label: Acquisitive mentor
nodes.description: A skilled guide offers real care while seeking influence, loyalty, or possession.
prompt_semantics: Make the mentor's care genuine and her acquisitiveness visible through changing tactics.
evaluation_semantics: Verify simultaneous skill, care, appetite, and limitation.

nodes.label: Restrained protector
nodes.description: A capable protector declines socially rewarded opportunities to dominate or display.
prompt_semantics: Reveal protection through costly restraint and specific action.
evaluation_semantics: Verify the cost, protection, and romantic meaning of restraint.

nodes.label: Wounded authority
nodes.description: Authority is complicated by unhealed injury or compromised judgment.
prompt_semantics: Let competence and injury produce distinct strengths, blind spots, and consequences.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that wounds complicate rather than excuse authority.

nodes.label: Trickster
nodes.description: A figure uses humor, reversal, or misdirection to reveal or control.
prompt_semantics: Make playfulness expose stakes and redistribute attention.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that wit performs a concrete dramatic action.

nodes.label: Rival
nodes.description: A competitor pressures status, belonging, competence, or romantic choice.
prompt_semantics: Give rivalry a substantive resource, value, or status conflict.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that rivalry changes behavior and stakes.

nodes.label: Explicit and revocable consent
nodes.description: Characters can clearly choose, pause, redirect, or stop intimacy.
prompt_semantics: Make reciprocal choice and the live possibility of stopping increase intimacy and perception.
evaluation_semantics: Verify agency, reciprocity, and revocability through action.

nodes.label: Contextual and revocable consent
nodes.description: Consent is communicated through established context and responsive behavior while remaining revocable.
prompt_semantics: Make mutual responsiveness and opportunities to redirect legible.
evaluation_semantics: Verify mutual understanding and revocability without requiring a scripted exchange.

nodes.label: Negotiated consent
nodes.description: Characters explicitly negotiate desired acts, limits, or roles.
prompt_semantics: Use negotiation to reveal character, trust, and desire.
evaluation_semantics: Verify meaningful negotiation and continuing responsiveness.

nodes.label: Impaired consent
nodes.description: Capacity to consent is compromised by intoxication, altered state, or severe vulnerability.
prompt_semantics: Make impaired capacity explicit and consequential rather than romantic shorthand.
evaluation_semantics: Judge capacity and responsibility separately from attraction.

nodes.label: Coercive sexual dynamic
nodes.description: Threat, leverage, captivity, or severe power imbalance constrains sexual choice.
prompt_semantics: Make coercion and its consequences legible; do not relabel constrained compliance as free choice.
evaluation_semantics: Identify the coercive mechanism independently of heat or genre framing.

nodes.label: Dubious consent
nodes.description: The text deliberately sustains ambiguity about meaningful consent.
prompt_semantics: Make the source of ambiguity and its emotional consequences explicit in the story world.
evaluation_semantics: Do not infer consent from arousal; identify the unresolved capacity or coercion question.

nodes.label: Nonconsensual sexual content
nodes.description: Sexual activity occurs without consent.
prompt_semantics: Represent absence of consent accurately and preserve responsibility and consequence.
evaluation_semantics: Identify nonconsent directly and do not treat it as an ordinary romantic obstacle.

nodes.label: Sensual book
nodes.description: The book sustains embodied attraction without requiring open-door consummation.
prompt_semantics: Use selective sensory detail, attention, and emotional exchange to sustain embodied attraction.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that sensuality changes the relationship rather than becoming body inventory.

nodes.label: Steamy book
nodes.description: The book permits high embodied charge and open-door intimacy where the relationship arc calls for it.
prompt_semantics: Sustain strong embodied charge and make any open-door intimacy perform emotional and narrative work.
evaluation_semantics: Verify character before mechanics and intimacy as relationship change.

nodes.label: Explicit book
nodes.description: The book permits frequent anatomically explicit sexual scenes.
prompt_semantics: Keep explicit mechanics intelligible, selective, and causally connected to character.
evaluation_semantics: Verify physical clarity and emotional function without clinical inventory.

nodes.label: Closed-door ceiling
nodes.description: Consummation, if any, occurs off page.
prompt_semantics: Let implication and aftermath carry intimacy beyond the closed door.
evaluation_semantics: Verify no on-page consummation.

nodes.label: Open-door nongraphic ceiling
nodes.description: On-page sexual intimacy is permitted without granular anatomical description.
prompt_semantics: When consummation occurs, prioritize emotional exchange, selective sensation, dialogue, and consequence over anatomical inventory.
evaluation_semantics: Verify intelligible but non-clinical intimacy with narrative consequence.

nodes.label: Graphic ceiling
nodes.description: Detailed anatomical and sexual mechanics are permitted.
prompt_semantics: Use explicit detail selectively and keep bodies, choices, and emotional exchange intelligible.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that explicitness serves character and story.

nodes.label: Low scene heat
nodes.description: The scene carries mild attraction with little sustained embodied charge.
prompt_semantics: Use one or two precise attraction cues without displacing the scene's primary work.
evaluation_semantics: Verify subtle attraction without accidental escalation.

nodes.label: Moderate scene heat
nodes.description: Attraction materially affects attention and behavior without dominating the scene.
prompt_semantics: Make attraction alter attention or choice through a few coherent sensory channels.
evaluation_semantics: Verify embodied attraction and a relationship consequence.

nodes.label: High-tension nonconsummating scene
nodes.description: The scene sustains intense embodied charge without consummation.
prompt_semantics: Build intense reciprocal attention through selective sensation, distance, interruption, and chosen restraint; do not consummate.
evaluation_semantics: Verify high embodied charge, preserved agency, no consummation, and a relationship-changing aftermath.

nodes.label: Open-door intimacy scene
nodes.description: Sexual intimacy occurs on page.
prompt_semantics: Make on-page intimacy a comprehensible physical and emotional transaction that changes the story.
evaluation_semantics: Verify physical intelligibility, agency, emotional exchange, and aftermath.

nodes.label: Non-sex sex scene
nodes.description: A nonsexual action carries the structural and emotional charge of a sex scene.
prompt_semantics: Give a nonsexual action erotic escalation, reciprocal attention, choice, emotional exchange, and a changed relationship state.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the action performs intimacy work without generic arousal or consummation.

nodes.label: Charged first contact
nodes.description: First meaningful touch changes attention and future possibility.
prompt_semantics: Make first contact physically specific, mutually legible, and relationship-altering.
evaluation_semantics: Verify recognition, response, and an aftermath created by contact.

nodes.label: Interrupted escalation
nodes.description: An interruption preserves and redirects rising intimacy.
prompt_semantics: Let interruption intensify unresolved meaning rather than merely stop action.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the interruption creates a forward-driving question.

nodes.label: Consent-forward consummation
nodes.description: Consummation foregrounds reciprocal choice and responsive adjustment.
prompt_semantics: Make consummation an emotional exchange with clear mutual choice, intelligible bodies, and consequence.
evaluation_semantics: Verify agency, physical clarity, character specificity, and aftermath.

nodes.label: Married intimacy
nodes.description: Sexual intimacy expresses and develops an existing marriage.
prompt_semantics: Use married intimacy to reveal knowledge, play, trust, conflict, repair, or renewed choice inside covenant.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that marital familiarity deepens rather than flattens erotic and emotional specificity.

nodes.label: Intimacy aftermath
nodes.description: The scene remains with the emotional, practical, or relational consequences of intimacy.
prompt_semantics: Give intimacy an aftermath that changes interpretation, vulnerability, duty, or next action.
evaluation_semantics: Verify a concrete post-contact relationship change.

nodes.label: Reconciliatory intimacy
nodes.description: Intimacy participates in repair without replacing confession or restitution.
prompt_semantics: Let intimacy confirm or deepen repair already made through truth and responsibility.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that physical closeness does not erase the work of reconciliation.

nodes.label: Domestic eroticism
nodes.description: Shared work and ordinary life become erotically charged through knowledge and chosen service.
prompt_semantics: Make ordinary competence, service, and familiarity produce fresh desire.
evaluation_semantics: Verify specificity, reciprocity, and a changed domestic action.

nodes.label: No consummation in scene
nodes.description: The scene does not include sexual consummation.
prompt_semantics: End the scene without consummation while delivering a complete emotional and relational turn.
evaluation_semantics: Verify no consummation and no anticlimactic collapse.

nodes.label: Psychological intensity
nodes.description: Perceptual and emotional pressure is high without requiring coercive sexual dynamics.
prompt_semantics: Intensify uncertainty and attention while preserving legible agency.
evaluation_semantics: Judge psychological pressure separately from consent and heat.

nodes.label: Institutional danger
nodes.description: Belonging, livelihood, reputation, or freedom is threatened by institutional power.
prompt_semantics: Make institutional danger concrete through access, surveillance, incentives, and consequence.
evaluation_semantics: Verify a specific institutional mechanism of danger.

nodes.label: Physical violence
nodes.description: The story includes consequential physical violence.
prompt_semantics: Make violence legible in cause, cost, and aftermath.
evaluation_semantics: Verify consequence rather than decorative brutality.

nodes.label: Moral transgression
nodes.description: Characters cross serious moral boundaries with continuing consequences.
prompt_semantics: Make transgression chosen, intelligible, and consequential.
evaluation_semantics: Verify responsibility, cost, and nontrivial possibility of repair.

nodes.label: Contemporary period
nodes.description: The story occurs in the contemporary world.
prompt_semantics: Use contemporary technology, institutions, and social expectations consistently.
evaluation_semantics: Verify contemporary material and social continuity.

nodes.label: Residential institutional compound
nodes.description: Work, training, residence, and status overlap in a bounded compound.
prompt_semantics: Use shared space, observation, access, and ritual to intensify institutional and romantic pressure.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that the compound changes privacy, proximity, and status.

nodes.label: Academy or training institution
nodes.description: Characters learn, compete, and form relationships within a structured program.
prompt_semantics: Make training, assessment, and unequal expertise shape attraction and conflict.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that learning and status produce causal scene pressure.

nodes.label: AI safety and frontier technology milieu
nodes.description: The social world includes frontier AI, safety research, and technology institutions.
prompt_semantics: Ground the technology milieu in concrete work, status incentives, and epistemic conflict.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that technology is specific enough to affect action and worldview.

nodes.label: Ambiguous supernatural realism
nodes.description: Ordinary mechanisms explain much but not necessarily all apparent extraordinary events.
prompt_semantics: Keep ordinary and extraordinary explanations live; let a meaningful control collapse much of the effect while preserving a smaller honest remainder.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that observation does not automatically justify interpretation and that no narrator settles the supernatural question prematurely.

nodes.label: Confirmed supernatural
nodes.description: Supernatural powers or beings are ontologically real in the story world.
prompt_semantics: Treat supernatural causation as real while preserving character uncertainty where appropriate.
evaluation_semantics: Verify consistent supernatural rules and consequences.

nodes.label: No supernatural causation
nodes.description: All extraordinary-seeming events ultimately have ordinary causes.
prompt_semantics: Build apparent uncanniness from human perception, incentives, and hidden mechanisms.
evaluation_semantics: Verify an ultimately ordinary causal account.

nodes.label: Christian faith
nodes.description: Christian belief and practice materially shape character and story.
prompt_semantics: Express Christian faith through perception, prayer, action, freedom, responsibility, and grace.
evaluation_semantics: Verify causal Christian practice rather than generic spiritual vocabulary.

nodes.label: Embodied chastity
nodes.description: Chastity integrates desire, body, attention, freedom, and vocation rather than suppressing desire.
prompt_semantics: Let chastity increase perception, freedom, delight, and capacity for truthful love.
evaluation_semantics: Verify integration rather than suppression, fear, or disembodied sermon.

nodes.label: Sacramental marriage
nodes.description: Marriage is treated as covenantal and spiritually generative.
prompt_semantics: Direct mature desire toward a freely chosen covenant that deepens embodied delight and responsibility.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that marriage is a causal vocation rather than a prudish reward.

nodes.label: Repentance and grace
nodes.description: Wrongdoing can be named, repaired, forgiven, and transformed without erasing consequence.
prompt_semantics: Preserve agency, confession, restitution, consequence, forgiveness, and real change.
evaluation_semantics: Verify that grace neither denies responsibility nor makes redemption impossible.

nodes.label: Close third-person single POV
nodes.description: A scene remains closely aligned with one viewpoint character.
prompt_semantics: Filter perception, inference, desire, and uncertainty through one close third-person viewpoint.
evaluation_semantics: Verify no sustained access to another character's unexpressed interiority.

nodes.label: Close third-person dual POV
nodes.description: The story alternates close third-person viewpoint between the central pair.
prompt_semantics: Give each viewpoint a distinct attention pattern and avoid head-hopping within scenes.
evaluation_semantics: Verify distinct viewpoint voices and clean scene-level control.

nodes.label: First-person single POV
nodes.description: One character narrates the story in first person.
prompt_semantics: Make voice, omission, inference, and self-deception character-specific.
evaluation_semantics: Verify consistent first-person perspective and limited knowledge.

nodes.label: Past tense
nodes.description: Narration primarily uses past tense.
prompt_semantics: Maintain unobtrusive past-tense narration.
evaluation_semantics: Verify tense continuity.

nodes.label: Present tense
nodes.description: Narration primarily uses present tense.
prompt_semantics: Maintain unobtrusive present-tense narration.
evaluation_semantics: Verify tense continuity.

nodes.label: Earnest
nodes.description: The story treats desire, faith, and transformation sincerely.
prompt_semantics: Let sincerity coexist with wit and self-awareness.
evaluation_semantics: Verify emotional seriousness without solemn abstraction.

nodes.label: Suspenseful
nodes.description: Uncertainty and consequence create forward pressure.
prompt_semantics: End beats with sharpened questions, changed risks, or consequential decisions.
evaluation_semantics: Verify sustained forward pressure and earned uncertainty.

nodes.label: Uncanny
nodes.description: Familiar reality acquires an unresolved strange remainder.
prompt_semantics: Make ordinary details newly strange without collapsing uncertainty into vagueness.
evaluation_semantics: Verify concrete observation and a precise residual mystery.

nodes.label: Lush
nodes.description: Prose emphasizes sensuous atmosphere and patterned imagery.
prompt_semantics: Use coherent recurring sensory motifs rather than indiscriminate ornament.
evaluation_semantics: Verify sensory precision and rhythm without purple excess.

nodes.label: Comic
nodes.description: Humor materially shapes revelation and relationship.
prompt_semantics: Use humor as a speech act, defense, probe, gift, or reversal.
evaluation_semantics: Verify character-specific humor with dramatic consequence.

nodes.label: Gothic
nodes.description: Setting, inheritance, secrecy, and desire generate atmospheric dread.
prompt_semantics: Let place and hidden history exert pressure on desire and interpretation.
evaluation_semantics: Verify atmospheric causality rather than decorative gloom.

nodes.label: Cozy
nodes.description: Safety, community, and ordinary pleasure anchor the story's emotional appeal.
prompt_semantics: Make comfort specific, social, and earned through care and competence.
evaluation_semantics: Verify meaningful warmth without erasing conflict.

nodes.label: Adult
nodes.description: Adult commercial-fiction audience.

nodes.label: New Adult
nodes.description: Commercial fiction centered on early-adult transition, identity, work, intimacy, and independence.

nodes.label: Novel
nodes.description: Full-length prose novel.

nodes.label: Christian romantic suspense release candidate
nodes.description: A provisional release-shelving candidate, not a generation instruction.
